source_locator.section: C07 wallet ownership and credit semantics

records.knowledge_statement: Visible wallets are distinct from ledger accounts and ownership is distinct from provenance. Unspent credit is customer liability, not revenue; no per-user escrow or blanket legal exemption is implied. Cash/gift/transferred components retain source-specific rights, expiry and withdrawal eligibility; ordinary transfer cannot create cashability. Pending/confirmed/reserved/spendable/withdrawable/transferable are distinct; active caps outrank consumption order. Store integer rials, display toman with explicit conversion; cumulative rounding is half-up. No banking/accounting/schema choice is made.
records.planning_implication: Cost/value and acceptance must distinguish customer liability, revenue and cashability; preserve provenance through transfers and corrections. Numeric rights and exact arithmetic are accepted; technology, bank, legal/accounting settlement remain open.
